$comment: Single source of truth for the skill monorepo-ref gate (OMN-8795 SD-08, widened by OMN-16850).
Consumed by scripts/skill_monorepo_refs.py, which backs BOTH the CI shell entrypoint
implementation and exactly one pattern list, so the two surfaces cannot drift.
Regexes are Python `re` syntax. This file is data, never scanned, so the literals below
do not need the '# local-path-ok' escape hatch the old in-source registries required.
OMNIBASE_PATH is the ALLOWED replacement vocabulary (OMN-16849): no pattern here matches
a fail-fast OMNIBASE_PATH read. Only its FAIL-SOFT forms are forbidden -- the whole point
of the rename is that the workspace root must never resolve silently to the wrong directory.

roots.why: the original SD-08 surface: internal skill docs, still gated
OMN-16855: the tree marketplace.json actually ships to customers -- the install commands live here, and the pre-OMN-16850 gate never looked at them
OMN-16855: published marketplace metadata, carries install_hint / install_hint_pipx
OMN-16855: the repo-root marketplace manifest, a second published copy of the same hints

patterns.message: Braced $OMNI_HOME expansion -- use ${OMNIBASE_PATH:?<message>}; ${OMNI_HOME:-.} silently resolves to the caller's cwd
Python read of OMNI_HOME -- use os.environ["OMNIBASE_PATH"] (fail-fast, no default)
CLI envvar binding to OMNI_HOME -- bind OMNIBASE_PATH instead
YAML/env declaration of OMNI_HOME -- declare OMNIBASE_PATH instead
Fail-soft OMNIBASE_PATH default -- the rename exists to remove silent cwd resolution; use ${OMNIBASE_PATH:?<message>}
environ.get("OMNIBASE_PATH", <fallback>) reintroduces the silent default -- use os.environ["OMNIBASE_PATH"]
Use 'onex run <node_name>' instead -- see OMN-8770 standalone install

patterns.note: local-path-ok: this registry IS the machine-path rule; the literal is the thing being enforced, not a violation
